NOTE
**Still not ready**

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | Description, "Fixes: #17419" and how it was tested are filled in |
| ✅  | Before/after screenshots were added in a comment |
| ✅  | Regression test added in `markdown_test_cases.json` (new push after the feedback) |
| ⚠️  | Self-review checklist is present, but it is a custom list, not the one from the PR template |
| ❌  | Commit discipline: the fixes ("fixed linting error", "added test case") are separate commits, not folded into the commit they belong to. The messages have no area prefix, and the test commit names the wrong issue (#17418) |
| ℹ️  | CI status is unknown. The description also has a typo ("methon"). |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and send the author the reply below.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for adding the test and screenshots, @adityas27. Two things are still missing: please squash the lint fix and the test into the commit they belong to, with proper messages following the [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html) (the test commit also says #17418 instead of #17419). Please also replace your custom checklist with the self-review checklist from the PR template.
```
